newsitem.title: UK: Eurosceptics threaten success of UK economy - Blair.
newsitem.headline: Eurosceptics threaten success of UK economy - Blair.

text.p: Opposition Labour leader Tony Blair warned on Wednesday that Eurosceptics who called for Britain to leave the European Union or rule out joining a single currency were a threat to the country's prosperity.

"Those who would argue either to close up our options on the single currency or who would argue for our withdrawal from Europe threaten our very existence as a successful economy," Blair said in a speech at Newcastle-upon-Tyne, northern England.
Blair said a Labour government would not say "yes" to every proposal from Brussels.

"But a policy of perpetual isolationism is really not a policy in Britain's interests. We will adopt a positive and sensible approach which allows us to attend to national interests in the best way possible," he added. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
